population.note_vs_old_baseline: The old adopted figure (153.8231 kWh/m^2) was pooled over a population of 8153. This restated figure is pooled over 8139. The two populations differ (8153 vs 8139) and are NOT the same census -- no delta between the two pooled EUI values is computed or implied here, per the plan's rule against differencing figures on different populations.

failures.note: 12 EnergyPlus FATAL input-error terminations (IDF-specific) + 1 CheckForRunawayPlantTemps divergence (unstable plant loop). Both are known EnergyPlus failure classes tied to the specific building's input, not to the T07 process, sbatch script, or cluster environment (see T07 progress-log entry).

methodology.floor_area_source: openubem.results.parser.parse_eio_zone_area() on each building's eplusout.eio (multiplier-aware simulated floor area per ruling 6 / OPEN-01), NOT the T06 rebuild manifest -- the manifest at %TEMP%/ubem_validation/t06_rebuild_2026-09-09/<cell>/step3/03_idf_manifest.parquet does not carry a floor_area_m2 column (columns: osm_id, idf_path, archetype_id, zoning_strategy, num_zones, num_context_buildings, simplification_status, data_quality_flag, generation_status, resolution_mode). This is a deviation from the dispatch instructions' stated source; flagged explicitly rather than silently substituted -- see T08 progress-log Deviations.
methodology.carbon: openubem.results.carbon.compute_gwp() applied unmodified, using openubem.config GWP_NATURAL_GAS_KGCO2_KWH and eGRID state factors (get_elec_factor: NY/CA/TX by city). dhw_gas_eui_kwh_m2 / dhw_elec_eui_kwh_m2 fed from the same raw WaterSystems:NaturalGas / WaterSystems:Electricity meters _parse_sql already sums into the combined dhw_eui_kwh_m2 column reported in the CSV -- an unmerging of the same quantities, not a new value. cooking_eui_kwh_m2 is fed as _parse_sql produces it (gas + electric cooking combined) into carbon.py's gas-only cooking term -- a known conservative gap in carbon.py, carried forward unmodified per instructions not to work around gaps in that module. No district-heating columns present (US fleet); all default to 0.0.
